m1m2_width.description: Channel width of the cross-coupled negative-gm pair (M1/M2) in each half_qvco_cell instance -- placeholder sizing, needs real gm/Id re-sizing for GF180MCU's nfet_03v3

m3m4_width.description: Channel width of the tail-coupling injection/cascode pair (M3/M4), gated by the neighbor half-cell's I_p/I_n -- placeholder sizing

m5_fingers.description: Finger count (nf) of M5 -- purely a layout/parasitic split of the same total width across parallel gate fingers (see ad/pd/as/ps formulas in half_qvco_cell.sch, which use W/nf as the per-finger width). Does NOT set the mirror ratio against nbias1 -- that is m5_mult.

m5_mult.description: Current-mirror ratio of each half-cell's tail transistor M5 against the shared nbias1 diode-connected reference M1 (vco_quadrature_lc.sch), i.e. instance multiplier (m=) of M5. Valid as a direct current ratio because m5_width/m5_length are tied to nbias1_width/nbias1_length (see derived_parameters.formulas.m5_width_matched/m5_length_matched) -- M5 and M1 use the same unit device, only replicated m5_mult times. Default of 50 with the project's default ibias=100n yields ~5uA tail current per half-cell (~10uA total block consumption, matching tests.vco.op's target).

nbias1_width.description: Channel width of vco_quadrature_lc.sch's own diode-connected M1 mirror transistor, which turns the block's external ibias current into the nbias1 gate voltage shared by every half_qvco_cell's M5. Also the unit width every M5 is tied to (derived_parameters.formulas.m5_width_matched) so the mirror stays matched.

nbias1_length.description: Channel length of the nbias1 mirror transistor. Also the unit length every M5 is tied to (derived_parameters.formulas.m5_length_matched) -- keeping L identical between the diode-connected reference and every mirror output is the single most important condition for accurate current mirroring (drain current is proportional to 1/L, so any L mismatch is a direct systematic current error).

m1_fingers.description: Finger count (nf) of the nbias1 mirror transistor -- purely a layout/parasitic split of its total width across parallel gate fingers, like m5_fingers. Does not affect the mirror ratio.

capvar_width.description: cap_pmos_03v3 (MOS varactor, standing in for sky130's cap_var_lvt) unit-cell channel width -- placeholder sizing.

capvar_mult.description: Number of parallel cap_pmos_03v3 unit cells, passed straight through as the device's own m= keyword (see sch/vco/half_qvco_cell.sch's C1/C3).

m5_width_matched.description: Ties each half-cell's M5 tail transistor width to the nbias1 diode-connected reference's width, so the current mirror uses a matched unit device (only m5_mult scales the ratio) -- passed as half_qvco_cell's own m5_width formal parameter instead of an independent leaf value.

m5_length_matched.description: Ties each half-cell's M5 tail transistor length to the nbias1 diode-connected reference's length, eliminating L mismatch between reference and mirror output -- passed as half_qvco_cell's own m5_length formal parameter instead of an independent leaf value.
